claims.text: Blanc Beta is Blanc built directly on Chromium, for Mac, Windows and Linux.
claims.evidence: Mac: The release is built from the fork's Chromium 158 tree (release.json chromiumVersion 158.0.8127.37); the approved release notes say the same. Windows: The release is built from the fork's Chromium 158 tree (windows-release.json's candidate windows-x64-24363262869b62ec, tree 7721085b0); the approved release notes say the same. Linux: The release is built from the fork's Chromium 158 tree (linux-release.json sourceCommit a52e29005, candidates linux-x64-400b354c5624ec89 and linux-arm64-4834316238c1f96d); the approved release notes say the same. The sentence names the three desktop builds because the panel also lists the iPhone and iPad TestFlight beta and the Android signup, which are not built on Chromium or not released.

claims.text: It installs beside Blanc and never replaces it.
claims.evidence: Mac: Own bundle id me.bnfy.blanc.beta and Blanc Beta data folder (release.json); profile-coexistence gate passed on the notarized app; the owner's webauthn checks confirmed the Electron app and its passkeys were untouched. Windows: Its own install folder (Blanc Beta), app id and Start menu entry; the runner's install check (44930438550) and the release's staging gate (44931963974) and verify-public (44932619481) record Electron Blanc's executable and uninstall entry unchanged through install. Linux: Its own package name (blanc-beta), install folder (/opt/bnfy/blanc-beta) and data folder (~/.config/blanc-beta); the release notes say the regular Blanc and its data are left untouched, and the update proof and verify-public legs (45103487653, 45108455963) install it from packages alone.

claims.text: Protected video, such as Netflix or Spotify.
claims.evidence: Listed under 'Not in this beta yet'. The beta ships without Widevine (enable_widevine = false), so protected video does not play. The no-drm-handoff gate passes: a site that asks for protected video gets a notice offering to open it in the released Blanc (the release's acceptance.json; waiver retired by the owner, 2026-11-17).

claims.text: Sync checked against the live Sync service.
claims.evidence: Listed under 'Not in this beta yet'. production-sync-real-device is waived under the owner's standing decision of 2026-11-14 (release.json gateWaivers); the release notes keep the caution that Sync isn't checked end to end.
